title: Help balancing and testing game heavily inspired by YGO FM
author: Asgavin
selftext:
Yo guys, I've been working on a game heavily inspired by Yu-Gi-Oh Forbidden Memories and other card games I like (Mostly Hearthstone and Balatro) and I wanted some opinions/help with the game.

Right now I would consider the state of the game pretty playable, I've been fixing any bugs I found and thinking of any features that might be needed but I am running out of ideas at this point haha.

The graphics maybe are a little rough considering they're pretty much all AI but to be honest I am not an artistic person and I usually don't care about graphics so I consider them good enough.

Right now I am mostly in need of help finding any other bugs and specially balancing the game.

Being someone that has played a lot of FM, a lot of very punishing mods and being the one that has made the game its pretty easy for me because I know everything so I wanted opinions from other people to see if its fine like it is or if there is a need for changes.

I've uploaded the game to [itch.io](http://itch.io) where you can download it for free: [https://asgavin.itch.io/fusion-realms](https://asgavin.itch.io/fusion-realms)

I recommend playing the tutorial when you start a new save, its very short and although most mechanics are from FM I've changed a few things like being able to use 1 magic and 1 fusion from hand each turn, how fusions work or how the defensive and offensive stances work.

I would appreciate any constructive criticism, I want to improve the game as much as possible after all, but to be honest anything related to changing the artstyle isn't a focus for me.

TL:DR: I am making a card game inspired by YGO FM you can download and test it for free here: [https://asgavin.itch.io/fusion-realms](https://asgavin.itch.io/fusion-realms)
